issue: दारिद्र दहन ऋण त्रासा — the line is two mātrās short of its chaupāī metre (16); a word may be missing (e.g. before ऋण). Drik Panchang is the only witness and web search found no independent copy.
our reading: (You) burn up poverty, (and) the dread of debt.
alternatives: A missing word, such as दारिद्र दहन करो ऋण त्रासा.

issue: हनुमत सहितासु गाई — सहितासु is unclear: सहित + सु ("well, with") or a slip for another word. Only one witness. Also होई मनोरथ सिद्ध जब: जब ('when') leaves the sentence hanging; it may be a slip for सब ('all wishes are fulfilled').
our reading: The āratī of Śrī Maṅgala, sung together with (that of) Hanumān. When wishes are fulfilled, at the end one goes to Viṣṇu's abode.
alternatives: हनुमत सहित सु गाई (sung well, with Hanumān's). होई मनोरथ सिद्ध सब (all wishes are fulfilled, and at the end one goes to Viṣṇu's abode).

issue: काल अकाल जुद्ध किलकारी: no verb; काल and अकाल may be Hanumān as Death and untimely death to the foe, or 'in season and out of season' (at every time).
our reading: In battle his war-cry is death to the foe, death before its time.
alternatives: At all times, timely or untimely, his war-cry rings in battle.

issue: रामदण्ड कालहु को दण्डा / तुम्हरे परस होत जब खण्डा: who is shattered by the touch is not named; Kāla (Death) is the nearest noun.
our reading: As Rāma's rod he punishes even Death; when he touches him, Death is broken in pieces.
alternatives: Death's own rod is shattered at his touch.
